sources.title: ANNnewsCH
sources.en: TV Asahi's official news channel: daily news, weather, press conferences and live streams in broadcast Japanese.
sources.tip: At N2, pick one short single-story clip, read the on-screen headline first, then replay the anchor's opening sentence until you catch every word.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @ANNnewsCH, channel id UCGCZAYq5Xxojl_tSXcVJhiQ matches yt.list; About says official channel of TV Asahi news department. Page shows no upload dates or caption info (cc left unknown). 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id lists latest upload dated 2026-10-23 (video title dated 2026-10-24). No Japanese name on page, so ja removed.

sources.title: TBS NEWS DIG Powered by JNN
sources.en: Official TBS and JNN news channel: breaking-news live streams plus reports made only for YouTube, in standard broadcast Japanese.
sources.tip: At N2, choose short reports and use the on-screen captions and headlines as a reading aid; at N1, try a live stream for a few minutes.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: name 'TBS NEWS DIG Powered by JNN', id UC6AG81pAkf6Lbi_1VC5NmPA matches yt.list; About says official TBS/JNN news channel. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-18.

sources.title: Nippon TV News
sources.en: Official channel of Nippon TV's news department: latest news, longer reports and live broadcasts.
sources.tip: At N2, pick a story you already know from English news, then listen for its key words before checking the captions.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: name 日テレNEWS, handle @ntv_news, id UCuTAXTexrhetbOe3zgskJBQ matches yt.list; About says official channel of Nippon TV news department. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-19 (morning news roundup).

sources.title: FNN Prime Online
sources.ja: FNN プライムオンライン
sources.en: News channel of the Fuji TV network's online outlet: politics, economy, society, world news and sport.
sources.tip: At N2, read the headline, watch a short clip once without captions, then again with them, and shadow one sentence.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: name FNNプライムオンライン, handle @FNNnewsCH, id UCoQBJMzcwmXrRSHBFAlTsIw matches yt.list; About says digital news outlet run by Fuji TV network stations. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-18 (evening news round-up).

sources.title: TV Tokyo BIZ Digest
sources.ja: テレ東《とう》BIZ ダイジェスト
sources.en: TV Tokyo's business and economy news channel: market and policy stories, analysis and original segments.
sources.tip: Use it at N1 once general news feels easy; keep a list of economy words from each clip and look them up afterwards.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: name テレ東BIZ ダイジェスト, handle @tvtokyobiz, id UCkKVQ_GNjd8FbAuT6xDcWgg matches yt.list; About covers economy, business and analysis. Page promotes a 14-day free trial of a paid service, so cost set to free+paid; the channel videos themselves play free. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (by handle) shows latest upload 2026-11-17.

sources.title: Yomiuri Telecasting Corporation News Channel
sources.ja: 読売《よみうり》テレビ ニュース
sources.en: Official news channel of Yomiuri TV in Osaka: news and features from the Kansai region, with some Kansai-accented speech.
sources.tip: Try it at N2 after standard Tokyo news feels easy, and listen for how the Kansai speakers end their sentences.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: name YOMIURI TELECASTING CORPORATION NEWS CHANNEL, handle @ytv_news, id UCv7_krlrre3GQi79d4guxHQ matches yt.list; About says official YTV news channel covering the six Kansai prefectures. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (by handle) shows latest upload 2026-11-02. Japanese name 読売テレビニュース taken from the vidIQ page title, not the YouTube page.

sources.title: NHK
sources.en: NHK's own public-relations channel: trailers, programme openings and short clips from Japan's public broadcaster.
sources.tip: At N3, watch short trailers and Shorts twice: once for the story, once to catch the title words. Full programmes are not here.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @NHK, id UCip8ve30-AoX2y2OtAAmqFA matches yt.list; About says NHK publishes it for public relations. Not a news channel. No dates or caption info on page. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-18 (a Short).

sources.title: Kurashiru
sources.en: Official channel of the Kurashiru recipe app: home-cooking recipe videos with steps shown as text on screen.
sources.tip: At N4, pause on each on-screen step and match the verb (cut, mix, fry) to what the hands are doing.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @Kurashiru, id UCE40kwov-UdhGikwAowjAAQ matches yt.list; About says official channel of the Kurashiru recipe app. Level raised from N5 to N4: on-screen text uses kanji and native-speed narration where present. Captions not confirmed. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-18.

sources.title: Tasty Japan
sources.en: Japanese edition of the Tasty food brand: quick cooking videos with Japanese text on screen and little speech.
sources.tip: At N4, write down the food words and units from the ingredient card, then rewatch and say each step aloud.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @TastyJapan, id UCilGprjH_UBgR5vLVXPff3Q matches yt.list; About says Japanese edition of Tasty (BuzzFeed). Speech and captions not confirmed. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-18.

sources.title: SCIENCE CHANNEL (JST)
sources.ja: サイエンスチャンネル
sources.en: Video library of the Japan Science and Technology Agency: short science news, how-it's-made films, experiments and nature.
sources.tip: At N2, start with the short science news videos; note the science terms, then watch again with Japanese captions if offered.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @jstsciencechannel, id UCHpFyLQgg4h9VZuFyby7RbQ matches yt.list; About says run by JST and that the library was folded into the Science Portal site in Nov 2020. Not just an archive: vidIQ stats page (by handle) shows latest upload 2026-10-09 (a Science Portal video news item). Level raised to N2: news videos are dense. Captions not confirmed.

sources.title: MiraikanChannel
sources.ja: 日本《にほん》 科学《かがく》 未来館《みらいかん》
sources.en: Official channel of Miraikan, the national science museum in Tokyo: videos about its exhibitions, events and researchers.
sources.tip: At N3, choose exhibition videos first, since the pictures carry the meaning; leave the longer talks for N2 and up.
sources.notes: Opened channel page 2026-11-20: handle @MiraikanChannel, id UCdBvq7IgL4U6u3CzeZaeoFg matches yt.list; About says official channel of the National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation. Captions not confirmed. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-16.

sources.title: JAXA
sources.ja: JAXA 宇宙《うちゅう》 航空《こうくう》 研究《けんきゅう》 開発《かいはつ》 機構《きこう》
sources.en: Official channel of Japan's space agency: mission updates, project explainers, launch footage and some videos for children.
sources.tip: At N2, watch launch and mission explainers where the footage shows what is said; pick the children's videos if the adult ones feel fast.
sources.notes: ADDED by reviewer (researcher's unverified @JAXA failed). Opened https://www.youtube.com/user/jaxachannel 2026-11-20: name 'JAXA | 宇宙航空研究開発機構', handle @JAXA-HQ, id UCfMIdADo6FQayQCOkLYGhrQ; About says JAXA shares its own videos and holds copyright. Japanese with an English About. 2026 activity: vidIQ stats page (third-party) for this channel id shows latest upload 2026-11-17. Captions not confirmed.

sources.title: JAXA Space Education Center
sources.ja: JAXA 宇宙《うちゅう》 教育《きょういく》 センター
sources.en: JAXA's space-education channel: lessons and talks about space and science made for school-age learners.
sources.tip: At N3, choose a short lesson video; the slower teaching style and diagrams make it easier than news. Note one new science word per video.
sources.notes: ADDED by reviewer (children's education). Channel linked from JAXA's own edu.jaxa.jp video page footer (/channel/UC8qJpbAlemL_kx2t4XqVqgg), which confirms it is official. Captions not confirmed.
